uppartners-infinitform:ashbyhq:c5b6140c-.title: Account Executive
uppartners-infinitform:ashbyhq:c5b6140c-.description: ABOUT THE COMPANY Founded by pioneers in computational geometry and design, FEA, HPC manufacturing, and software architecture, InfinitForm stands at the forefront of AI engineering design. The company’s transformative platform streamlines the design-to-manufacturing process, integrating seamlessly with various manufacturing methods to optimize cost, speed, efficiency, and performance. InfinitForm unifies computational geometry, physics-based simulation, and various manufacturing constraints into a single generative engine that produces manufacturable, lightweight and high performance prismatic designs. By collapsing analysis, optimization, and DFM into one workflow, our platform reduces engineering cycles from days or weeks to minutes – driving significant improvements in cost, performance, and innovation velocity. Backed by leading investors, we raised a $12.7M Seed round in May 2025 and are now scaling our team ahead of our 2026 launch. THE ROLE We're seeking an Account Executive to own our early customer acquisition and help shape InfinitForm’s go-to-market engine. You’ll be the first dedicated salesperson, working directly with the CEO, Business Development, Marketing and Product, and to refine our sales motion, close foundational customers, and establish the patterns that will later scale into our full GTM organization. You'll be supported by a dedicated Sales Engineer for technical demos and POC execution. This is a category-creation opportunity. You're not displacing competitors — you're defining a new market in generative manufacturing design. Every major aerospace, automotive, defense, and industrial manufacturer represents greenfield territory and a potential commercial opportunity. This role is ideal for someone who has sold technical, engineering-driven software (CAD/CAE/CAM, PLM, simulation, manufacturing, or similar) and thrives in early-stage environments. You’ve taken a deeply technical product from early pilots into repeatable enterprise deals and know how to sell to engineering leaders inside complex manufacturing organizations. We have a strong existing pipeline with active pilots demonstrating measurable design-cycle reductions and cost savings. RESPONSIBILITIES SALES EXECUTION - Own the full sales cycle from prospecting → demo → trial→ close - Build pipeline through outbound outreach, events, partnerships, and customer referrals, in collaboration with cross-functional teams. - Engage credibly at both the individual practitioner level (to uncover workflow pain and drive adoption) and the C-suite level (to align on strategic outcomes, ROI, and risk) - Partner with a dedicated Sales Engineer to deliver technical demos and manage POCs - Maintain tight deal hygiene, forecasting accuracy, and CRM discipline GTM FOUNDATION & PROCESS BUILDING - Help define our initial sales playbook, ICP, and segmentation - Shape early messaging and positioning with Marketing and the CEO - Capture customer insights and translate them into actionable product feedback - Build early sales collateral: case studies, demo scripts, ROI calculators, etc. - Identify expansion opportunities in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, and industrial manufacturing CUSTOMER SUCCESS COLLABORATION - Ensure a smooth handoff into onboarding and customer success - Help drive usage, measurable value realization, and expansion opportunities - Build referenceable customers who can support early credibility and category creation SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - Consistent pipeline generation and early closed-won enterprise logos - Strong technical buyer engagement and short feedback loops with Product - High-value, multi-year contracts with visible customer ROI - Early vertical playbooks emerging from your customer conversations and wins - A clear, repeatable sales motion that future reps can follow QUALIFICATIONS - 5 – 8+ years of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales e

verdane-stacc:teamtailor:7adb4812-ad34-4.title: Software Developer to Irori
verdane-stacc:teamtailor:7adb4812-ad34-4.description: Irori’s mission is to make systems integration easy. As the world moves toward pervasive connectivity we enable high throughput, real-time event driven architectures that make trusted data accessible for consumers. We work with critical systems in finance, retail, telco, medtech and government sectors where we provide specialist skills and managed software for customers. Role We are seeking integration developers who are motivated by teamwork and innovative technology. At Irori we cover a range of technologies including Event Streaming, Container Orchestration, Identity Management, Process Automation and API Management. We specialize in solutions based on Kafka and Kubernetes and have a lot to offer for candidates with this interest. We typically help customers to modernize service platforms and develop effective digital products. This can involve launching new financial products, enabling mobile payments for retail or simply making a set of core services more data driven. We work as technical specialists and organize complete product teams for customers. In addition to consulting Irori develops commercial software in the area of streaming data services. Irori offers functionality for disaster recovery, schema registry, Kafka connect, observability and data governance. We are based in Stockholm and we have team members across Sweden. We aim to be the global leader in systems integration and hire with this vision in mind. Working with top level talent ensures continuous growth and learning. Expectations We expect that you have a few years experience in systems development. More importantly, we think you are passionate about learning how to apply innovative technologies for customer benefit. The technology landscape is always evolving and it is our job to explore and evaluate how to capture value from new technology. In addition to advanced technical skills we expect you to have an interest in people. In our experience the greatest challenge in creating solutions is often our ability to collaborate and find appropriate trade offs as a team. This requires that we have social and communication skills not only to work effectively together but to actually motivate each other and create a fun-filled collaborative culture. Your exact prerequisite skills are less important than your attitude to learning. We are a diverse team in terms of technical passions today, and this helps us to cover a wider set of considerations as we build solutions. Qualifications You have a software engineering background or similar. You have a few years experience in backend development and may have an interest in container orchestration and cloud infrastructure as well. You either have experience with or an interest in some of the following technologies: Kafka, Kubernetes, OpenAPI, .Net.core, Quarkus, Spring Boot, Prometheus, Helm, Jaeger. You speak English fluently, and Swedish at an intermediate level. The journey We will provide you with qualified consulting assignments to match your level of experience. Most of the time you will be working in a team of colleagues as an integral part of a customer product team. On top of this, you will participate part time in in-house product development according to interest. Irori ties continuous training to our product development which ensures everyone gets hands-on experience with new technologies. This keeps our knowledge base up to date, and gives us the experience to guide customers to successful technology adoption. We work in a fully transparent culture and make decisions together. Application We look forward to your application. We will review your application and book an interview if qualifications are met.

westcap-hopper:ashbyhq:1546aad3-dfde-4a9.title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
westcap-hopper:ashbyhq:1546aad3-dfde-4a9.description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. WHAT WOULD YOUR DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE: - Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. - Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. - Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. - Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. - Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. - Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. - Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. - Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications - 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. - Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. - AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. - Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. - Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies

yc-zip:ashbyhq:e183b27b-fbc3-4baf-8d27-f.title: Principal Product Manager, Global Payments Platform and Controls
yc-zip:ashbyhq:e183b27b-fbc3-4baf-8d27-f.description: ABOUT ZIP Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. YOUR ROLE As a Principal Product Manager on the Payments team, you will own the systems and strategy that power Zip's global payments infrastructure and make Zip the safest and most seamless way to pay vendors across tens of billions in annual spend. You will drive product development across the payments platform -- including bank integrations, payment provider partnerships, payout management, and payment routing -- as well as payment controls covering risk and fraud prevention, bank account verification, payment onboarding, currency management, and payment compliance. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Payment Operations, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable payment infrastructure, proactively mitigate payment fraud, ensure smooth and secure payment onboarding, and manage payment compliance with confidence at enterprise scale.
